# transmit_oncall_escalation_policy (Resource)

Who to page, and when, until someone acknowledges. Alerts, integrations and heartbeats route to a configuration and an escalation policy.

Deleting is refused while heartbeats still point at the policy, and for a policy that has paged incidents (it is kept for their history); stop routing to it instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "transmit_oncall_escalation_policy" "default" {
  configuration_id = transmit_oncall_configuration.prod.id
  name             = "Default"
  owner_team_id    = transmit_oncall_team.sre.id

  # Page whoever is on call now...
  step {
    schedule_id = transmit_oncall_schedule.primary.id
  }

  # ...then the team lead if nobody acknowledges within 10 minutes.
  step {
    delay_seconds = 600
    responder_id  = transmit_oncall_responder.lee.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration_id` (String) The on-call configuration this belongs to. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `owner_team_id` (String) Team that owns the policy.
- `step` (Block List) A step pages one responder, or whoever a schedule has on call, `delay_seconds` after the incident opens, unless it was acknowledged first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Optional:

- `delay_seconds` (Number) Seconds after the incident opens. Defaults to `0`.
- `responder_id` (String) Page this responder. Set exactly one of `responder_id` or `schedule_id`.
- `schedule_id` (String) Page whoever this schedule has on call.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <configuration_id>/<policy_id>
terraform import transmit_oncall_escalation_policy.default 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
```
